rule: Thresholds are frozen before candidate fitting. Insufficient samples remain prospective shadow and cannot be promoted.

candidates.horizon: all automated unit, integration, and replay cases
candidates.allowed_state: production only after every invariant passes

candidates.horizon: at least 8 prospective weeks and 2 calendar months
candidates.insufficient_sample_action: retain deterministic zero for platform/official exclusions; keep source-derived canonical promotion shadow-only
candidates.allowed_state: production safety rule after invariant and precision gates

candidates.unit: independent games with a pregame-known QB1 absence and qualified replacement
candidates.horizon: at least 2 seasons with expanding-season holdouts; prospective shadow until minimum is reached
candidates.baseline: zero absent starter and leave replacement baseline unchanged
candidates.insufficient_sample_action: keep transfer shadow-only; production retains zeroing without transfer

candidates.unit: independent games, including at least 40 timestamped QB-state changes
candidates.baseline: registered scoring-environment plus PBP descriptor model
candidates.insufficient_sample_action: display sourced facts only; no numerical contribution claim
candidates.allowed_state: descriptive after quality gates; predictive requires separate registration

candidates.unit: independent player-games carrying QUESTIONABLE or DOUBTFUL pregame designation
candidates.horizon: at least 2 held-out seasons and 8 prospective weeks
candidates.insufficient_sample_action: participation_probability remains null and baseline projection is retained
candidates.allowed_state: shadow until every calibration gate passes

candidates.unit: independent qualified absence games per position family
candidates.horizon: at least 2 held-out seasons per RB, WR, and TE candidate
candidates.insufficient_sample_action: position remains shadow-only and unresolved opportunity is displayed

candidates.unit: settled predecision prop observations across at least 100 independent games per market family
candidates.horizon: at least 1 full held-out season plus 8 prospective weeks
candidates.baseline: same distribution model without availability context
candidates.insufficient_sample_action: research distribution only; no edge or recommendation label
candidates.allowed_state: predictive research; betting authority requires a new prospective registry entry

candidates.unit: prospectively recorded, executable decisions across at least 100 games
candidates.allowed_state: betting decision only after a separately reviewed prospective result
